UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User account profile for CCTV candidate identification station with role-based access control and admin approval workflow.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

name.description: Full display name of the officer or user.

full_name.description: Full name recorded during registration request.

mobile_number.description: Official contact or mobile telephone number.

status.description: Operational approval status of the account.

user_id.description: Activated human-readable forensic User ID (e.g. CVS-US-102948).

approved_at.description: Timestamp when account was approved by an administrator.

approved_by.description: UID of the administrator who approved the registration.

rejected_at.description: Timestamp when account registration was rejected.

rejected_by.description: UID of the administrator who rejected the registration.

rejection_reason.description: Optional notes or reason provided by administrator for rejection.

/users/{userId}.description: Collection storing user profiles and forensic role definitions.
